title: Rename the app to Cairn
acceptance: PRODUCT_NAME, display name, scheme and project are Cairn
Bundle identifiers become com.calvinbrown.Cairn, com.calvinbrown.Cairn.ShareExtension and com.calvinbrown.Cairn.UITests
The app group becomes group.com.calvinbrown.Cairn and the CloudKit container becomes iCloud.com.calvinbrown.Cairn, in both entitlements files and in AppGroup.swift
Directories Stacks/, StacksShareExtension/ and StacksUITests/ become Cairn/, CairnShareExtension/ and CairnUITests/, moved with git mv so history follows
Swift symbols named for the app are renamed: StacksApp, and any Stacks-prefixed type or test class
README and ROADMAP call the app Cairn
Tools/seed-simulator.sh targets the new bundle id and app group
No occurrence of the old name survives outside .claude/ and this task history
The gate passes and the app builds clean
notes: EXCLUSIVE TASK — must run alone. It renames directories every other task edits, so a concurrent worktree would face unresolvable rebase conflicts. Do not dispatch until the fleet is empty. FULL rename decided 2026-08-25 after the owner confirmed nothing saved matters: the app group and CloudKit container are renamed too, so no legacy identifiers survive into the public repo. This orphans the existing on-device library and any synced records — accepted deliberately and explicitly, and cheap right now because the only data is the owner test data and T-0004 has never confirmed sync works at all. EXPLICIT CONSTITUTION EXCEPTION granted by the overseer: X7 forbids agents changing signing or identity. This task may change the three bundle identifiers, the app group identifier and the CloudKit container identifier. It may NOT change DEVELOPMENT_TEAM — that is the signing identity and has nothing to do with the rename. The repo directory itself (~/Documents/stacks) is NOT renamed: factory scripts, worktree paths and the settings allowlist all use absolute paths through it. Renaming the checkout is a separate later human operation.
